topic: General Classes and Uses of Organic Compounds
key_concepts: Hydrocarbons contain only carbon and hydrogen
Molecular and condensed structural formulas represent organic molecules
Saturated hydrocarbons have single carbon-carbon bonds
Unsaturated hydrocarbons have double or triple carbon-carbon bonds
Alkanes, alkenes, and alkynes differ by single, double, and triple bonds
Methane is the simplest alkane and a component of LPG
Ethene is an alkene that aids fruit ripening
Ethyne or acetylene is an alkyne used as welding fuel
Functional groups determine specific properties and reactions of organic compounds
Alcohols contain hydroxyl groups and are used as disinfectants and solvents
Ketones and aldehydes are carbonyl-containing compounds with solvent and preservative uses
